gaps.name: real-qr-raster-decode
gaps.detail: QR geometry, quiet-zone, contrast and decoder-unavailable semantics are implemented. Production rasterization plus a real QR decoder adapter is still required for rendered-output decode proof.

gaps.name: production-text-measurement
gaps.detail: CJK-safe measurement semantics are implemented and fail closed when unavailable. Browser/server shaping adapters backed by the actual rendering font stack remain to be wired.

gaps.name: identity-feature-baseline
gaps.detail: Identity threshold validation and unavailable handling are implemented. Governed visual-feature baselines, model versions and calibrated thresholds remain production integration work.

gaps.name: all-mutation-export-entrypoints
gaps.detail: NODE-38-compatible preflight and batch/export gates exist. Canvas, Agent, worker and export entrypoints still require repository-wide migration/audit so none can bypass the validator.

gaps.name: bounded-external-validator-execution
gaps.detail: Adapter absence/errors fail closed for HARD rules. Production timeout/circuit-breaker execution and durable validation telemetry remain to be integrated around expensive external validators.
